articles.summary: Today, DICK'S Sporting Goods (NYSE: DKS) announced a new partnership with Lids to introduce dedicated Lids shop locations inside DICK'S stores nationwide. The partnership will expand access to Lids' industry-leading assortment of licensed headwear while enhancing the in-store experience for sports fans. articles.title: DICK'S Sporting Goods Announces Partnership with Lids to Launch Lids Shops Inside 100 DICK'S Locations

articles.title: DICK'S and adidas Celebrate FIFA World Cup 2026™ with Star-Studded "Where It All Kicks Off" Campaign
